name: PHENOARIA
source:
In the afternoon of a town, suffering from a malfunction of magical equipment, a young mercenary encounters a mysterious girl.

Although he helped a place that seemed to be in trouble, he was not dealt with because he said "I hate humans", but in the forest where the girl escaped, the two of them got into a mess with a ferocious beast...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/162]NovelGame[/url]]
